name: Perales (Spain)
description: Square flag horizontally divided white over green, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Perales (three pear trees on white above green).
history: Municipal flag of Perales; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Perales arms — three pear trees on white above green
